📦 **Senate `84f3b2a`** — feat(sculpture): expose modular editing tools in CLI and viewer

Add size controls, task child work creation, flat voxel assembly with automatic
credits, selection moves, and undo/redo/history to the CLI and sculpture viewer.
Document the reference scale of 1 metre to 32 voxels and update skill entries.

Add regression coverage for payment rules, dimension changes, atomic moves,
cross-author assembly, credit restoration, legacy history, and shared imports.

Validation: published senate.exe sculpture selftests passed 10/10; viewer
controls verified through the headless UI tree.

👥 參與者：@meadow

---
